decision: Added one dated professional event; no permanent provider or report entry added.

event.name: Performance Excellence Digital Forum 2026
event.description: Free online GPAU forum on strategy execution, organizational maturity, performance measurement, AI and institutional improvement, with academic discussions, PMI research and organizational case studies. December 9, 09:30-15:30 UTC (03:30-09:30 U.S. Central; 12:30-18:30 Riyadh). Registration required. A provider-led professional event that also promotes paid assessments and training, not a peer-reviewed research conference. Some speakers remain unannounced; recordings are not confirmed.
event.source: GPAU official dated agenda and The KPI Institute announcement of October 14, 2026, checked November 7, 2026. https://news.kpiinstitute.org/gpau-announces-performance-excellence-digital-forum-2026/ Original summary; no blanket reuse license established. Online event, distinct from the separate Riyadh awards gala.
event.keywords: GPAU; Global Performance Audit Unit; performance measurement; organizational maturity; strategy execution; institutional evaluation; AI; PMI; management research; online forum; performance culture

editorial_fit: Selected for strategy, institutional evaluation and performance-measurement research. Commercial assessments and training are disclosed. University participation does not make all provider claims independently validated.
methodological_boundary: GPAU explicitly states that its maturity models assess management tools, processes and architecture, not whether organizations achieve their performance targets. Maturity scores must not be presented as measured organizational impact.
geographic_boundary: This is a globally accessible online forum, not a Saudi-hosted physical event. Riyadh is the advertised agenda time zone. The separate 2027 Riyadh gala was not added.
access_and_rights: Free event registration is advertised; no registration submitted. Presentations are advertised for attendees, but a recording was not confirmed. Full Maturity Outlook reports require registration and were not examined. Copyright remains with original publishers; no text or images copied.
